desc: Define the four diagonal directions and their clockwise successor mapping.
Design and verify DP states for straight continuation and for continuation after one clockwise turn.
Handle alternating values (`2`, `0`, `2`, `0`, ...) and the initial `1`, including length-one segments.
Prove that every valid segment is represented by choosing its initial direction and optional single clockwise turn.
Implement `lenOfVDiagonal` with O(nm) time and O(nm) auxiliary space, checking all cells containing `1`.
Test against the four provided examples and boundary cases such as a single cell, no `1`, and turns at the first or last possible position.
